    if n['color'] == 'N':
        rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
        cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
        center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
        center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
        greens.append((center_r, center_c))

# Group by row

by_row = defaultdict(list)
for r, c in greens:
    by_row[r].append(c)
for r in sorted(by_row.keys()):
    print(f"Row {r}: {len(by_row[r])} blocks at cols {by_row[r]}")

# Collect all from first row

    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': first_row, 'col': c}])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    green_count = sum(1 for n in seg if n['color'] == 'N')

    print(f"Click ({first_row},{c}): Green={green_count}, GO={go}")

        break
